name: BACH_0110
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is Normal only and all 5 similar cases agree. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%; others <1% | Single dominant class |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90% level) | Unambiguous |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 68th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 6) · context · Descriptive only; score above typical · Weak
- **Dead cell fraction** (regions 3, 9, 10) · context · 97th percentile of reference; direction check failed · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit more than random removal (+0.54, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Lymphocyte spot check is weak (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dead-cell and epithelial-fraction features failed direction checks, and only 3 regions were segmented.
- Conformal and calibration checks come from 132 test images in 24 patient groups.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: closest to invasive in the heatmap; confirm no stromal invasion or atypia.
2. **Regions 3, 9, 10**: high dead-cell fraction; confirm debris or necrosis versus artifact.
3. **Region 6**: flagged lymphocyte-rich by a weak concept; confirm the infiltrate on the slide.
